description: The signed-in company's matched tenders — the list in Przetargowy Janusz built from its profile (CPV codes, voivodeships, budget): view 'recommended' (filtered by what the company does, when its profile says so) or 'all'. 50 per page, each with fit_score (0–100), has_summary, an app_url and the public url. Without CPV codes in the profile there is no list — the answer says so with a link to the profile. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

deadline_before.description: ISO date; only tenders with submission deadline before it

max_value.description: Maximum estimated value (PLN); overrides the profile budget

min_value.description: Minimum estimated value (PLN); overrides the profile budget

regions.description: Voivodeships (slug or name from list_facets); default: the company profile

name: list_matched_tenders
title: Przetargy dopasowane do firmy
